businesses.business: oil and gas production enhancement services

offering_description.value: Provides production optimization solutions for oil and gas wells, mainly artificial lift, gas compression and related equipment. Customers are exploration and production operators, mostly in US shale basins. It owns and operates the equipment and services it at the wellsite under contracts.

primary_products.value: natural gas compression units; gas lift systems; vapor recovery units; plunger lift equipment; production automation equipment

primary_services.value: equipment rental and operation; wellsite production optimization; compression services; equipment maintenance and field service; methane emissions management

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas exploration and production operators, including large independents and majors

end_markets.value: oil and gas exploration and production; midstream natural gas

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: monthly fees for company-owned compression and artificial lift equipment in operation at customer wells; service fees: field service, maintenance and production optimization; product sales: some equipment and parts sold to customers
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates compression and lift equipment at customer wellsites, serving E&P operators; service provider: installs, maintains and optimizes production equipment for oil and gas producers

geography_served.value: US national: US onshore basins, including Permian, Eagle Ford, Haynesville, Marcellus, Bakken and Rockies

specialization.value: related lines: gas compression, gas lift, vapor recovery and other artificial lift and production equipment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: field-based sales and service teams contracting directly with E&P operators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: oil and gas operations subject to EPA methane and air emissions rules and state energy regulators

notes: Details based on general recall; product mix and basin list are approximate.
